name: ssc-website-analytics
description: Secret Sauna Company website with analytics

scripts.//events:test: Requires a sibling ../ssc-ops checkout: the stream-separation scenarios load the REAL shared tracker from it. Without it the suite fails with that message rather than passing on a stub.
scripts.//fonts:test: Group B drives a real Chromium against dist/, so run `npm run build` first. Static checks alone cannot tell you a font actually loaded.
scripts.//rhythm:test: Group R drives a real Chromium against dist/, so run `npm run build` first. A token's declared value and the value that reaches the element are different claims — and an edit (or mutation probe) made to styles.css WITHOUT a rebuild never reaches the measured page: it reports as 'suite did not notice', a coverage gap that isn't there.
scripts.//lint:css: The guard that keeps the type scale and the radius collapse from drifting back: raw font-size and border-radius literals are rejected outside :root. Six exceptions exist and every one carries a stylelint-disable-next-line with its reason.
